name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature, subsystem, or architectural improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or subsystem.

## Motivation & Use Case
Why is this needed? Which OS personality or core subsystem does it support (POSIX/VFS, NT Object/Async I/O, Mach IPC, GPU/Vulkan)?

## Proposed Design
Outline the high-level design, crate placement (`kernel/` vs `crates/*`), and any public specifications referenced.

## Clean-Room Confirmation
- [ ] This proposal is based solely on public specifications, academic papers, or original design (no proprietary source code or decompiled binaries).
